patch.summary: Close implementation guide: day-zero sequence, pilot rules, plan gates, and cutover checks from SoftwareGlimpse research — not generic CRM setup filler.

blocks.body: Implement Close by mapping current crm workflows to Close objects, confirming plan gates for pipeline management (Essentials, Growth, Scale), workflow automation (Growth, Scale), sales automation (Growth, Scale), piloting one team, then cutting over integrations (WhatsApp Business, Slack) after data checks.
bullets: Gate check: pipeline management (Essentials, Growth, Scale)
Integrate after: data quality pass on WhatsApp Business

blocks.heading: Close day-zero to steady-state sequence
blocks.body: Treat Close setup as a controlled rollout — not a weekend dump of CSV files.

scenarios.title: Day zero — objects and owners
scenarios.body: Define owners for contact management, lead management, pipeline management before inviting the whole org.

scenarios.title: SMB pilot
scenarios.body: One pipeline / one team proves Inside sales and outbound teams that live on phone/email/SMS before company-wide seats.

scenarios.title: Cutover
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes briefly; validate WhatsApp Business and Slack before reopen.

steps.label: Go when plan unlocks cover pipeline management (Essentials, Growth, Scale)
Pause if this limitation blocks ops: Growth (list price annual) and Scale (list price annual) per-user pricing is high versus pipeline-only CRMs; calling usage and premium phone lines add cost.
Do not expand seats until contact management is green

items.title: Mistake 1
items.body: Growth (list price annual) and Scale (list price annual) per-user pricing is high versus pipeline-only CRMs; calling usage and premium phone lines add cost.

items.title: Mistake 2
items.body: Advanced Chloe automation/workflows and predictive dialing depth are concentrated on Growth and Scale.

items.title: Mistake 3
items.body: Calling is usage-based; AI credits are pooled monthly with plan caps and no rollover.

items.title: Mistake 4
items.body: Growth/Scale seat pricing is expensive versus pipeline-first CRMs

items.title: Big-bang invite
items.body: Inviting every user before object design creates junk data that is expensive to unwind.

blocks.title: Close plan gates that affect rollout
blocks.body: Implementation fails when unlocks needed for go-live sit on a higher tier than budgeted.

lines.label: Solo
lines.description: 14-day trial · Unlocks: contact management, lead management, deal management · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Essentials
lines.description: 14-day trial · Unlocks: pipeline management · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Growth
lines.description: 14-day trial · Unlocks: workflow automation, sales automation · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Scale
lines.description: 14-day trial · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

blocks.title: Validate crm fit before a deep Close rollout
blocks.body: If Close fails constraint fit, stop implementation early.

checklist.label: Draft Close object owners before invites
Confirm plan unlocks for go-live features
Pilot one team on contact management
If blocked, evaluate Pipedrive before sunk-cost expansion
